evidence.detail: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY points DESC, wins DESC, person) AS finish is computed after the WHERE clause filtering, so a person-name text search recalculates rank 1..N within the filtered result set

The text search filter `clauses.text_match_where(query.person_query(), q)` is merged into the same `where` string as competition_id/season filters, all passed to load_leaderboard() as the inner WHERE clause — so the ROW_NUMBER window function sees only the filtered rows
No fixing commit found for this issue
prepare_leaderboard sets entry.position from entry.finish (the ROW_NUMBER), confirming that positions 1-8 get the circled-number glyphs — wrong when calculated on a filtered set

triage.fix_sketch: Add an `outer_where: str = 'TRUE'` parameter to `load_leaderboard()` in `decksite/data/competition.py`. Wrap the existing SQL as a subquery and apply `outer_where` and the ORDER BY/LIMIT in the outer query, keeping `COUNT(*) OVER ()` in the outer SELECT as the new total. In `decksite/controllers/api.py`, extract the person-name text filter into `outer_where` and keep only competition_id/season filters in the inner `where`.
triage.notes: The SQL query is ~50 lines and complex; the subquery wrapper is straightforward but needs careful testing to ensure total counts, ordering, and all callers of load_leaderboard() still work correctly.
